discovery_notes: Loungefly 2020 cell. 30 standard searches, snippets only, mostly Disney Pins Blog. Loungefly.com LE series (Apr-Dec 2020, LE 500-2,500, $25) recorded as single pins; Robin Hood pin-on-pin held. 4-pin OE packs held (character lists only, per 2021 precedent). Blind boxes: chases recorded; other lineups held except Mulan (retailer per-design list). Star Wars/Marvel keys reused from 225_b096 as corroboration. No packet 256 (BoxLunch 2020) existed at write time; BoxLunch items keyed loungefly-boxlunch-*.
